episodes.title: Andrew Tate’s Lawyer Claims He's Being Treated Like Jeffrey Epstein in Jail | Oxygen
episodes.description:
As influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate fight extradition to the UK, they remain in jail in Miami. Their attorney says the allegations against them, including rape and sex trafficking, has “put a target on their back” behind bars. The Tate brothers have denied all allegations against them.

episodes.title: How A Self Help Guru Created An Alleged Cult with a "Much Darker" Reality | Oxygen
episodes.description:
Nick Maslow, People Executive Director, spoke exclusively with Oxygen about Cult of the Soulful Journey, and learning about a self-help guru who created a “much darker” reality for their recruits. Soulaire Allerai has denied all allegations against her and rejects claims she has operated a cult. Oxygen has reached out to Allerai for comment. People Magazine Investigates: The Cult of the Soulful Journey premiered on ID and is available to stream on HBO Max.
